findings.detail: The added finite grammar substantially addresses the original missing-init/phase gap, but still certifies three impossible original histories. (1) It permits a lightning episode to end at step8, and the positive lightning_client_form emits server expired(a=1)/new_timer/timer_set plus strikes but omits both sound pairs. Actual ss_updt.c272-327 unconditionally makes both sound calls for that server expiry; a real client does not emit the first3 server timer events. (2) The weather-phase check requires only inside-frame/not-tod-open/not-facts-pending, so a complete episode before the first TOD or after its sound-fact pair still passes, contradicting update_server TOD->weather/lightning->sound order. (3) check_boot skip_free accepts rain/fixed tags inside the parser-session block; positive boot_with_tags emits rain1->fixed(DRY) before parser_session_end. Actual parsgen.c1209-1211 ends that block immediately after random-weather initialization; rain/wind tags are later cases, and only rain0 invokes fixed(DRY),1311-1318. These are malformed positive fixtures/false-completeness paths, not a demonstrated C or weather-numerical defect.
